Sample analysis and trait-placement review

0128362a9e65957a295a41cabc2e328c610cfa7937050e3e51f95e583708c5ca
Identification: IBM General Decimal Arithmetic dqXor.decTest, version 2.59.
Verdict: BENIGN; retain existing documentation and test-row traits, no change.
All 27,853 bytes are ASCII. Every non-comment/nonempty line is one of seven
arithmetic directives or 348 XOR test rows. Python decimal.Context(prec=34)
agrees with every expected result and Invalid_operation condition. There are
no executable commands, includes, imports, external dependencies or payloads.
The recovered HexDecode strings come from the numeric operands, not a decoder.
The one URL is an informational comment, not a network operation.

Fetched the referenced http://www2.hursley.ibm.com/decimal (unavailable) and
its official successor https://speleotrove.com/decimal/ plus dectest.html and
dectest.zip. The official site explicitly documents its move from IBM's host.
The ZIP's dqXor.decTest version 2.62 has exactly the same test rows, arithmetic
settings and remaining content. Only version, copyright, contact details,
URL and newline representation differ. No hostile dependency or URL payload
was found. Possible explanation for the external malware label: collection
contamination or a heuristic reacting to XOR and long digit runs. The exact
reason for the external label is unavailable.

f30851fa5a6f32f6540d8723235f7a03e210980cc21cb61cb070acc709817282
Identification: Trivial.54.d DOS search-and-overwrite virus, 54-byte carrier.
Verdict: MALICIOUS.
16-bit real-mode entry 0100h: AH=54h is immediately overwritten with 4Eh.
DX=0132h points to '*.*', and INT 21h finds the first matching file. The
BH += CBh / BH -= CBh pair cancels. AX=0026h is overwritten with 3D02h;
DX=009Eh selects the default DTA filename for an update open. BH=B5h is
replaced with 40h; XCHG AX,BX installs the returned handle and AH=40h.
DX=0102h and CL=34h request 52 bytes of its own image at file offset zero.
BX += 00DAh / BX -= 00DAh cancels. INT 21h overwrites the victim prefix;
JMP +0 and RET terminate via the PSP. No error checks, append, host-byte
preservation, disk writes, network operations or residency are present.
A Unicorn run with mocked DOS calls confirms the search, update open and
52-byte overwrite. This is a defective replicator: dropping the first two
bytes without relocating addresses degrades subsequent copies. The initial
unauthorized file corruption is unambiguous despite that defect.
Existing supported-format coverage: four hostile traits across infection,
header-corruption and Trivial identity directories. No new signature needed.

eddd6aaa0fc39e85afd9d1ac49df499113b9bd4fcd2f96a14ef305b16ae3e34a
Identification: Trivial.Iota.56 changing-key DOS COM overwriter.
Verdict: MALICIOUS.
AH=4Eh, DX=011Ch, CALL 0127h enters the shared transform/syscall routine.
CX=001Fh, SI=0108h, XOR BYTE [SI],1Fh, INC SI, LOOP decrypts bytes 0108h
through 0126h. CX is then set to 0038h and INT 21h runs find-first on the
now-decoded '*.COM' mask. RET enters the decoded body at 0108h:
  INC BYTE [012Fh]      increment the immediate key in the XOR instruction
  MOV DX,009Eh          found filename in the default DTA
  MOV AX,3D02h / INT 21h / XCHG AX,BX
  JMP 0122h             skip embedded '*IOTA*.COM' data
  MOV AH,40h / MOV DX,0100h
Fall through into the same XOR loop re-encrypts the body using the new key.
The shared INT 21h now writes all 56 bytes from 0100h into the opened file
at offset zero, destroying its original entry and copying the virus. RET
terminates via the PSP. Unicorn with mocked DOS calls confirms three full
infection generations, with output keys 20h, 21h and 22h. No host recovery,
resident hook, network behavior or disk-sector operation is present.

Trait changes:
- Move the two neutral byte-XOR loop observations into crypto/symmetric/xor/
  loop, with names/descriptions that assert transformation, not decryption.
- Move generic register setup plus near CALL into binary/code/control-transfer;
  the matched bytes alone do not establish that the callee XORs anything.
- Move encrypted self-image write setup into fs/write/file/handle. Bind hostile
  overwrite classification to an actual decoded DTA-opening path.
- Add key-independent call/XOR/DTA detection binding CALL target, transform
  bounds, key increment destination, COM mask pointer, returned file handle,
  jump target, own-image buffer and complete copy count. No IOTA text required.
- Extend the existing Trivial encrypted-family identity using that path,
  preserving the previous encrypted layout and staying within the leaf budget.
- Rename the unsupported generic 'encrypted virus body' conviction to a
  suspicious observation of an XOR loop with a call or guard. A protector
  can use those mechanisms without being a virus.
- The decryptor rollup now requires the complete decoded path instead of
  accepting an isolated neutral SI byte-XOR loop as body decryption evidence.
Exact YAML consumers were updated; ancestor directory selector searches found
no additional YAML consumers of the moved subtrees requiring preservation.
check.py exercises 25 positive and negative controls, including changed keys,
changed unused family text, disconnected paths and the previous identity.

Scanner routing limitation:
The exact supplied DOS paths are typed unknown by both cleave facts and
atomscan. This type does not run inline YARA and rejects these rules' concrete
file-type gates. Rule authors cannot declare for: [unknown]: the loader rejects
it. Byte-identical .com and .bin controls route as dos_com/data and expose the
expected findings (Trivial.54.d: four hostile; Iota: two hostile). Original-path
re-scans therefore remain empty. This is an engine/file-identification gap,
not evidence of benign behavior; changing sample bytes or using filename-based
malware convictions would hide the problem. No engine changes were made.

Validation migration: four existing Cascade/Sirius fixture expectations named
the removed generic encrypted-virus-body conviction. Update them to require
the renamed suspicious observation (min_suspicious=1) and their unchanged
separate infection trait (min_hostile=1). No fixture is relabeled benign and
no infection requirement is removed. The lost hostile count was the
unsupported generic XOR/call-or-guard inference, not an observed attack.
